program_narrative: Program TSTVAL00 is a batch test-validation driver. It opens three sequential input files (TEST-CASES, EXPECTED-RESULTS, ACTUAL-RESULTS) and the output TEST-REPORT, writes the report heading 'TEST VALIDATION REPORT', clears its test metrics and records the start time. It then reads TEST-CASES one record at a time until end of file; for each test case it selects the test routine by TEST-TYPE (FUNCTIONAL, INTEGRATE, PERFORM or ERROR) and then validates the results, updates the metrics and writes a test detail line, but all of those routines are in paragraphs that are not present in this source, so their logic cannot be traced. After the last test case it records the end time, computes elapsed time and the success rate (passed / total x 100) and writes a summary line with total, passed and failed counts. Error conditions handled: any file that fails to open and an unknown test type both display a message on the console, set return code 12 and end the run immediately.
